source_text.body:
Send and split money by chatting with your AI agent
An MCP in front of a wallet lets an agent send and request money, split dinners, trips and poker ledgers, with passkey approval or preset trusted contacts.
·
Nov 24, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
Versine is an MCP in front of a self-custodial USDC wallet on Base. The agent works out who owes what, then calls the MCP to send or request money, up to 100 people at once. Each one-time payment needs a passkey or biometric approval in the mobile app. Trusted contacts can be paid without approval. People without accounts get a claim link after verifying an OTP.
How it went
The source is a launch post, so it gives no results or usage numbers. It positions the product for power users splitting dinners, trips and poker ledgers, and says it is live on iOS, Android, ChatGPT and Claude.
Worth knowing
Trusted contacts skip approval, so the post says to add only people who would return money if your agent made a mistake.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Connect to my [wallet or payments MCP] and help me split [a dinner / a trip / a poker night] with [names of people]. Work out who owes what from these details: [amounts, who paid, any exceptions]. Show me the full list of requests or payments, with names and amounts, and wait for my approval before sending or requesting any money. You're done when I've confirmed and each person has a request or payment queued.
Original source: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50634426
